children: A10 Networks (NYSE: ATEN) today announced it is appointing Mary C. Henry to the Board of Directors, effective October 5, 2026. Henry spent 18 years at Goldman Sachs, primarily as a communications technology analyst in the firm’s Investment Research division. She joins current directors, Tor R. Braham, Peter Y. Chung, Eric Singer, Dhrupad Trivedi, and Dana Wolf.

“Mary’s experience, leadership and perspective will be extremely valuable as A10 continues to execute on its strategic objectives and strengthen its leadership in AI security and related infrastructure. We look forward to her contribution to our growth as a member of the Board,” said Dhrupad Trivedi, President and Chief Executive Officer of A10 Networks.

“A10 is at the forefront of supporting AI infrastructure build-outs and helping customers secure their AI deployments. It’s an exciting time to join the Board of Directors and participate in shaping the company’s long-term growth opportunities,” said Mary C. Henry.

As a top-ranked analyst at Goldman Sachs, Henry was named a Partner and Managing Director of the firm in 1996. During her tenure, Henry was personally involved in company financings that totaled tens of billions of dollars, in addition to driving multiple strategic projects. She collaborated with research, investment banking and private equity colleagues to evaluate companies in technology and communications services worldwide and worked extensively with major institutional investors around the world. She retired in 2004. Since then, Henry has served on corporate and educational boards and is currently a member of iCivics’ Board of Directors. Henry graduated from Northwestern University with an undergraduate degree in economics and a graduate degree in journalism.

A10 Networks (NYSE: ATEN) delivers secure application and network solutions designed to protect, optimize, and scale business-critical systems across on-premises, hybrid cloud, and edge environments.
